Helpful notes

Frequently asked questions

Do I need to book a tourist spot?

No. The system is for planning. Public sightseeing places may simply be stops in your itinerary. Confirm local rules or fees before visiting.

Can I add a resort?

Yes. Select any resort shown in the list. Resort charges vary; confirm current day-tour, swimming, cottage, and overnight rates with the resort. Enter your expected resort cost in the optional “Other cost” field.

Does this website save my plan permanently?

This version does not use a database. You can print or save your plan as a PDF, or copy the summary. It does not send a booking request or store personal information on a server.
